source: Mahabharata, Critical Edition (BORI), Adi Parva, adhyaya 3 (Paushya parva: Janamejaya's long sacrifice at Kurukshetra, the son of Sarama, Sarama's curse)
structure: Every episode: RECAP (≈3 s; KIT.series.recapStrip) → HOOK (one question, Sauti at the Naimisha fire; the episode title follows it: KIT.series.episodeTitle) → STORY → NEXT (a cliffhanger line, then the teaser card: KIT.series.nextTeaser).

voice.note: speaker → script/cast.json (voice, speed, pitch). Per line: speed (× the speaker's), pre/post (ms of silence before/after the voice, used by the timeline), say (what is spoken, if not `text`): '…' and '—' pause, ',' and '.' pause a little, [p:400] pauses 400 ms, {s:0.8} speaks what follows at 0.8× until the next {s:…} ({s} resets).

lines.text: The story was first told at King Janamejaya's sacrifice.
lines.note: RECAP. The Naimisha fire at night, Sauti seated by it; the series 'Previously' strip; in the smoke above the fire, a vision of Janamejaya pouring ghee (beats[0] = 'Janamejaya's': the vision glows)

lines.speaker: sauti
lines.text: But before that… this king was cursed. By a dog.
lines.say: But before that… this king was cursed. [p:300] By a dog.
lines.note: HOOK (Sauti, at the fire). beats = 'cursed' (the king's vision darkens, a low drum), 'dog' (the smoke turns into the luminous profile of a great dog, head high); the episode title shows in the post

lines.text: At Kurukshetra, Janamejaya and his brothers were performing a long ritual.
lines.note: STORY 1. The sacrificial enclosure at Kurukshetra by day: sacrificial posts, the pavilion, the fire; Janamejaya pours ghee; his three brothers behind him. The episode title rises in the first seconds. beats = 'Kurukshetra' (the place name), 'brothers' (they are named), 'ritual'

lines.text: A small dog came near: the son of Sarama, the divine dog.
lines.say: A small dog came near: [p:150] the son of Sarama, the divine dog.
lines.note: STORY 2. The pup trots in, curious, sniffing; on 'Sarama' (beats[1]) her luminous profile glows in the sky above him

lines.text: The king's brothers beat him, though he had done nothing wrong.
lines.say: The king's brothers beat him, [p:300] though he had done nothing wrong.
lines.note: STORY 3. The brothers rise with their staffs; ticks = the three blows (drum hits), never shown landing: the shadows fall across the pup; beats[2] = 'nothing': the untouched offerings beside him

lines.text: He ran crying to his mother. And Sarama came to the king.
lines.say: He ran crying to his mother. [p:300] And Sarama came to the king.
lines.note: STORY 4. The pup runs across the plain to his mother in her dawn-pearl light; on 'Sarama' (beats[1]) she lifts her head; on 'king' she strides into the enclosure and the daylight dims

lines.speaker: sarama
lines.text: My son did no wrong. So an unseen danger will fall upon you.
lines.say: My son did no wrong. [p:400] So an unseen danger… [p:150] will fall upon you.
lines.note: STORY 5 (the turn). Sarama towers over the king, head high; ominous low drums. beats = 'wrong', 'unseen' (the sky darkens, the fire gutters), 'you' (a shadow falls over the king)

lines.text: Afraid, Janamejaya searched for a priest to protect him.
lines.say: Afraid, [p:250] Janamejaya searched for a priest to protect him.
lines.note: STORY 6 (resolution of this arc). Night in the palace at Hastinapura: the king walks past lamps and seated priests, looking from face to face. beats = 'Afraid', 'priest'

lines.text: Far away, a young student was about to face the serpent king.
lines.say: Far away, [p:250] a young student was about to face the serpent king.
lines.note: NEXT (cliffhanger). A forest road at dusk: a young student walks toward us; behind the hills a vast cold-green hood rises. beats = 'student', 'king' (the hood flares, its eyes open)
the teaser card (KIT.series.nextTeaser), with a glimpse of episode 6: Takshaka's hooded shadow over the two earrings
